knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The cycle begins with the source document, which shows what happened and when, before anything is journalised.
Asset accounts increase on the debit side, so an increase in an asset is recorded as a debit.
An entry whose debits and credits differ does not balance and must be corrected before posting; it is not completed by adding a balancing expense.

practicalCriteria: Learner journalises ten supplied source documents for one sample month, with debits equal to credits on every entry, and the posted ledger balances agree to the totals of the journal.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Journal and ledger report saved with date and version
Assessor record of knowledge check result
stopWorkCriteria: Learner posts an entry that does not balance
Learner treats a GST treatment as settled without checking it
